verses.1: A prayer for deliverance from David’s troubles.
verses.2: The LORD will answer you on the day of trouble. He will bring down your name, O God of Jacob.
verses.3: Send your help from the Holy Land and from Zion; they will guide you.
verses.4: He will remember all your offerings and sacrifices. They will be remembered forever.
verses.5: It will give you your whole heart and all your wisdom.
verses.6: May your days be filled with joy, and in the name of our God, may Jehovah answer all your prayers.
verses.7: Now I know that the Lord, His Messiah, will answer him from His holy place in power and glory.
verses.8: These are chariots, and these are horses. We ride them in the name of Jehovah, our God.
verses.9: Many of them fell and died. But we stood up again and continued our journey.
verses.10: May Jehovah save the king, and may he answer us on the day we call out to him.
